# Environment Gate
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

| Check | State | Evidence or limit |
|---|---|---|
| Application stack | Confirmed | Existing Laravel, Inertia React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui source in `application/source/` |
| Server or database impact | Not applicable | The increment is client-side only |
| Browser Fullscreen API | Requires validation | Support and permission vary by browser; the normal responsive fallback remains available |
| Secure context | Open for staging | Native fullscreen commonly requires HTTPS outside local development; existing Gate 1 and staging HTTPS controls remain applicable |
| Test harness | Limited | No frontend browser-test framework is present; static checks and manual browser evidence are required |

The environment gate does not block local implementation. It does limit the claim to local implementation until supported mobile browser and staging HTTPS evidence exists.
